The episode covers 3 transaction(s) totalling $439.61, and 27 other card(s) are linked through device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080.

sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C13487, card C13487-K1, issued as a mastercard debit. Between 2016-11-15 and 2016-11-26, 3 transaction(s) totalling $439.61 were identified as part of one fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3460634. The activity took place online, product code(s) C, billing region(s) 191, from device profile(s) SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. The transactions were purchases from one device profile used across several customers' cards. The activity is assessed as an undocumented coordinated pattern: Device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 (seen on only 52 cards ever) made 60 purchases on 28 different customers' cards within 19 days, 100% marked New and 100% behind an anonymous proxy; Device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 appears in 4 confirmed-fraud closed case(s) (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035), labelled undocumented by the analysts. The same device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080 links this activity to 27 other card(s), including C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, which indicates a common actor across cardholders. Earlier confirmed cases CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985 show the same pattern. The cardholder has not yet been contacted. The bank has recommended BLOCK_CARD, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS and opened an internal case; the report is filed under R9, §3a.
